headers.description: Optional headers to send with the request as a dictionary of header values.

Content-Type.description: The media type of the resource being requested, typically 'application/json'.

Authorization.description: The credentials to authenticate a user agent with a server, typically formatted as 'Bearer {token}'.

timeout.description: The maximum amount of time to wait for a response from the server, in seconds. A longer timeout may be necessary for slower network connections or overloaded servers. This is a float type value.

params.description: URL parameters to append to the URL. Sent as a dictionary of key-value pairs.

query.description: The query parameter for search or filtering.

page.description: The page number parameter for pagination. Used to retrieve a specific page of results.

auth.description: HTTP authentication credentials formatted as a (username, password) tuple.

cert.description: Path to the SSL client certificate file (.pem), if required for the request.

cookies.description: Cookies to send with the request as a dictionary of cookie names and values.

sessionid.description: Session identifier cookie, used to recognize client sessions on the server.

csrftoken.description: CSRF protection token cookie, used to prevent cross-site request forgery attacks.

proxies.description: Proxy settings as a dictionary, mapping protocol or protocol and hostname to the URL of the proxy.

http.description: Proxy URL to use for HTTP requests, including the port number.

https.description: Proxy URL to use for HTTPS requests, including the port number.

stream.description: Whether to stream the download of the response. If False, the response content will be immediately downloaded. Streaming is useful for handling large files or responses.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate or not. Set to False to skip certificate verification, which is not recommended unless you are sure of the server's identity.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑start guide to a few popular IP‑lookup APIs that return **company‑level data** (including contact information when available). All of them expose a simple HTTP GET endpoint that accepts an IP address and returns JSON. | Service | Key Features | Typical Endpoint | Example Request | Example Response | Pricing | |---------|--------------|------------------|-----------------|------------------|---------| | **ipinfo.io** | • Business IP lookup (ASN, org, name, domain, phone, email)
• Geo‑location, carrier, timezone
• Free tier (50k req/month) | `https://ipinfo.io//json` | `https://ipinfo.io/8.8.8.8/json?token=YOUR_TOKEN` | ```json{ "ip":"8.8.8.8","hostname":"dns.google","city":"Mountain View","region":"California","country":"US","loc":"37.3860,-122.0840","org":"AS15169 Google LLC","postal":"94035","timezone":"America/Los_Angeles","readme":"https://ipinfo.io/missingauth"} ``` | Free (50k req/mo), Paid ($5/mo for 1M req, $20/mo for 5M req, etc.) | | **ipstack.com** | • Business IP lookup (ASN, org, domain, phone, email)
• Geo‑location, carrier, timezone
• Free tier (10k req/day) | `https://api.ipstack.com/?access_key=YOUR_KEY` | `https://api.ipstack.com/8.8.8.8?access_key=YOUR_KEY` | ```json{ "ip":"8.8.8.8","type":"ipv4","continent_code":"NA","continent_name":"North America","country_code":"US","country_name":"United States","region_code":"CA","region_name":"California","city":"Mountain View","zip":"94035","latitude":37.386,"longitude":-122.084,"location":{"geoname_id":0,"capital":"Washington D.C.","languages":[{"code":"en","name":"English","native":"English"}],"country_flag":"https://assets.ipstack.com/flags/us.svg","country_flag_emoji":"🇺🇸","country_flag_emoji_unicode":"U+1F1FA U+1F1F8","calling_code":"1","is_eu":false}} ``` | Free (10k req/day), Paid ($10/mo for 50k req, $30/mo for 250k req, etc.) | | **ipapi.co** | • Business IP lookup (ASN, org, domain, phone, email)
• Geo‑location, carrier, timezone
• Free tier (1k req/day) | `https://ipapi.co//json/` | `https://ipapi.co/8.8.8.8/json/` | ```json{ "ip":"8.8.8.8","city":"Mountain View","region":"California","region_code":"CA","country":"US","country_name":"United States","country_code_iso2":"US","country_code_iso3":"USA","country_capital":"Washington D.C.","country_tld":".us","continent_code":"NA","in_eu":false,"postal":"94035","latitude":37.386,"longitude":-122.084,"timezone":"America/Los_Angeles","utc_offset":"+01:00","country_calling_code":"+1","currency":"USD","languages":"en-US,es-US,pt-BR,fr-CA,zh-CN,ja-JP,ko-KR,ru-RU,ar-SA,hi-IN,pt-BR,es-ES,fr-FR,zh-TW,ko-KR,ru-RU,ar-SA,hi-IN,pt-BR,es-ES,fr-FR,zh-TW"} ``` | Free (1k req/day), Paid ($9/mo for 50k req, $29/mo for 250k req, etc.) | | **ipgeolocation.io** | • Business IP lookup (ASN, org, domain, phone, email)
• Geo‑location, carrier, timezone
• Free tier (1k req/day) | `https://api.ipgeolocation.io/ipgeo?apiKey=YOUR_KEY&ip=` | `https://api.ipgeolocation.io/ipgeo?apiKey=YOUR_KEY&ip=8.8.8.8` | ```json{ "ip":"8.8.8.8","continent_name":"North America","continent_code":"NA","country_name":"United States","country_code2":"US","country_code3":"USA","country_capital":"Washington D.C.","country_tld":".us","state_prov":"California","state_code":"CA","district":"Mountain View","city":"Mountain View","zipcode":"94035","latitude":"37.3860","longitude":"-122.0840","time_zone":{"name":"America/Los_Angeles","offset":"-0700","current_time":"2024-08-06 12:34:56","current_time_unix":"1722921296"}} ``` | Free (1k req/day), Paid ($9/mo for 50k req, $29/mo for 250k req, etc.) | --- ## How to Use (Python Example) ```python import requests def get_company_info(ip, service='ipinfo', token=None): if service == 'ipinfo': url = f"https://ipinfo.io/{ip}/json" params = {"token": token} elif service == 'ipstack': url = f"https://api.ipstack.com/{ip}" params = {"access_key": token} elif service == 'ipapi': url = f"https://ipapi.co/{ip}/json/" params = {} elif service == 'ipgeolocation': url = f"https://api.ipgeolocation.io/ipgeo" params = {"apiKey": token, "ip": ip} else: raise ValueError("Unsupported service") resp = requests.get(url, params=params, timeout=5) resp.raise_for_status() return resp.json() # Example usage if __name__ == "__main__": ip_address = "8.8.8.8" api_token = "YOUR_API_KEY_OR_TOKEN" data = get_company_info(ip_address, service='ipinfo', token=api_token) print(data) ``` --- ## Things to Keep in Mind 1. **API Keys** – All services require an API key or token. Sign up on their websites to obtain one. 2. **Rate Limits** – Free tiers are usually limited to a few thousand requests per day/month. Upgrade if you need higher volume. 3. **Contact Data Availability** – Not every IP belongs to a business; many are residential or public. Contact info (phone, email, domain) is only returned for business IPs. 4. **Privacy & Compliance** – Ensure you comply with GDPR, CCPA, or other privacy regulations when storing or using IP‑derived data. --- ### Quick Summary - **ipinfo.io** is the most straightforward for business IPs and includes `org`, `domain`, `phone`, and `email` fields. - **ipstack.com** and **ipapi.co** offer similar data with slightly different field names. - **ipgeolocation.io** is a solid alternative if you prefer a different pricing model. Pick the one that best fits your volume and budget, sign up for an API key, and start querying!
